response.text: {"label": "timing_arithmetic", "reason": "The sub sends C3 then 3C, but it raises tvalid only after waiting for busy to fall, so the second handshake comes after the transmitter has gone idle (sub `408 ... tx busy_fall 0` / `408 ... tx hs 3c`). The target needs tvalid to rise on the stop-end clock with tready low, which gives the back-to-back reload with no busy_fall seen in gold `83 ... tx hs 3c`."}
